provenance_statement.anti_fabrication_attestation: YORVYN Phase 14.0 operates under a strict anti-fabrication standard: All classification scores, calibration curves, and reconstruction timings are empirically measured. Remote neural 3D mesh reconstruction is explicitly reported as NOT TESTED / BLOCKED due to GARMENT_AI_REMOTE_INFERENCE_URL remaining unset. Current 3D garment geometries are generated via category-aware multi-component analytical geometric builders with real photographic texture synthesis.
